front_blocks.md: A lamp on a 240 V supply and a lamp on a 12 V supply carry the same current, yet the 240 V lamp glows more brightly. Explain why, in terms of energy transfer.

back_blocks.md: The 240 V lamp has a potential difference 20 times greater than the 12 V lamp. Since potential difference is the **energy transferred per unit charge**, each coulomb of charge transfers 20 times more energy to the 240 V lamp, making it shine more brightly.
